params.name: order_number
params.description: Unique identifier for an Order that includes a cart index prefix

items.docs: The `order_number` parameter is the identifier of the order

params.name: o
params.description: The Order number. To retrieve multiple labels, pass in multiple "o" params

params.name: pdf_type
params.description: Specify the type of PDF label. Can be one of [additional_docs, canada_pdf, multi_page, single_page]

params.name: size
params.description: Set predefined or custom sizes. Can be one of [desktop, thermal, custom]

params.name: page_width
params.description: The page width in inches

params.name: page_height
params.description: The page height in inches

params.name: page_top_margin
params.description: The top margin in inches

params.name: page_left_margin
params.description: The left margin in inches

params.name: label_width
params.description: The label width, within the page, in inches

params.name: label_height
params.description: The label height, within the page, in inches

params.name: label_orientation
params.description: The label orientation. Can be one of [portrait, landscape]

params.name: label_rotation
params.description: The degree of rotation for the label. Can be one of [0, 90, 180, 270]

params.name: return
params.description: Get a return label or a forward label based on this boolean field

items.docs: Get labels for each order number passed in to the `o` parameter
